purpose: Hand-authored Messages protocol baseline; never send before separate real-channel authorization. No endpoint or authentication value is included.
authentication: Operator supplies authentication in memory after authorization; no value in this artifact.

content.text: Use read exactly once on probe.txt and report its contents. Do not guess.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace.

history_warning: Suffix is synthetic offline data, not a claim of real execution. Real follow-ups must use the newly observed assistant blocks and actual read result, never this suffix.
history_followup_prompt: Using only the previous actual read result, repeat its contents. Do not call tools again.
forced_case_followup_rule: A3 forces read on the first request only. After the one actual read, omit tool_choice on the result request to allow final text. Reusing forced choice would demand another tool call and violate the one-read boundary.

cases.stop: Stop on error, no tool_use, unexpected tool/path, second tool call, missing terminal, or after first successful round-trip.

cases.side: Mica Provider + Engine + read; align request fields, declare system differences
cases.stop: Same as A1. Run once; outcome differences alone do not establish a Mica bug.

cases.requires: A1 or A2 returned no tool_use and exact target model/channel supports forced choice with thinking disabled
cases.stop: Same as A1; no unsupported-mode retries; do not change product defaults.

cases.side: offline native-slot versus generic Completions-facts comparison
cases.stop: Compare id/input object/role/block order/result linkage. Never upload synthetic success as a real tool fact.

cases.base: baseline plus newly observed native Messages tool round-trip
cases.requires: New-session round-trip established; history generated in a new authorized isolated experiment
cases.stop: Stop on first status/terminal; no extra tool execution.

cases.base: new Completions tool facts with same task/schema as H1; append history_followup_prompt after completed round-trip
cases.side: Messages encoding of generic facts from newly isolated Completions run
cases.requires: One Completions read round-trip (at most two requests), then one Messages history request; record content/result-envelope differences
cases.stop: Stop on first Messages status/terminal; no additional tool execution, no retry after 400.

runtime_rules: All live cases are NOT executed by this worker.
Keep the same authorized model, schema, prompt, output budget, thinking configuration and API version; default auto means omit tool_choice on both sides.
Use a fresh isolated workspace and exactly one designated random-content UTF-8 file; no existing user sessions.
Capture only field names/types/counts/link-match booleans/status/tool events/terminal flags; never persist raw live bodies, keys, endpoints or absolute paths.
No Responses requests. No blind retries. No write/edit/bash/ask execution. Each request uses a 30-second bound and zero automatic retries.
If H1 cannot reuse an authorized successful A1/A2 history, stop for a revised budget; do not silently add requests.
